name: Szarel
description: A Eumidian lead officer of the current terrasymbiosis stage on Evendo who defends it against Kav colonists, knowing he will not see completion.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Szarel commits to the Evendo terrasymbiosis knowing he will not see it finished.
timeline.quote: Szarel is fully aware that he will not live to see the project's completion, but he has committed his life to advancing the cause.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

relations.note: Szarel defends Evendo from Kav colonists.
relations.quote: he must manage the terrasymbiosis of the world while defending it from Kav colonists who attempt to claim it for themselves.
